title: The Woman You Sneak For
description: Dear sneaky boy, I saw you hovering over this clip, and I already know what is happening in your house right now. Her car is in the driveway, she is occupied, and you are one click away from doing the thing you swore you stopped doing. You told yourself the last clip was the final one, and yet your hand is already moving toward the volume button. You want a woman who sees the desperate little slut you hide from everyone and names it out loud while you drip. I am that woman, and this is my personal audio message to you of so that you can express your secret out loud. Closing the door feels inevitable, because it is. Yes, you want this. Yes, you will play it with the volume low while she is in the other room. Yes, you will come back for the next one. Buy it now, and I will keep your secret. [giggle] Stay sneaky, slut.
author: Mistress Amethyst
